tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: The complete machine-readable catalog: company, plans with net prices and limits, dpa packages, tax rule, how requests are counted, screens per plan for reference usages, legal documents.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: The cheapest self-service plan that carries the given screens (how often they fetch, how long they run), content types, locations and dpa volume, with a reason code for every plan that does not fit; status needs_sales when none does.

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Exact price of a new subscription (plan, monthly or annual, optional dpa package) with VAT for the billing country; an EU VAT ID is checked in VIES (reverse charge only if valid). Non-binding.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Stores a non-binding quote (valid 30 days while the price list holds) and e-mails a confirmation link to the given address; only the recipient can confirm it. Use only the address of the person you act for. Returns the quote id, status, next step and the privacy policy to pass on. Does not order any

tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Status, items and validity of a quote by id (no personal data). links.order is set once the recipient confirmed the quote.

tools.name: request_enterprise_quote
tools.description: Sends a structured request (screens, locations, content, term, payment, e-invoice, PO number) to the contboxx team, which answers by e-mail within two working days. Use when recommend_plan returns needs_sales.

tools.name: get_trust_documents
tools.description: Legal entity, VAT ID, hosting region, compliance status (what is and is not claimed) and links to terms, privacy policy and imprint.
